entities.summary: Middlesex University, branded as Middlesex University London (MDX), is a public research university based in Hendon, northwest London, England. The university also has campuses in Dubai and Mauritius. The name of the university is derived from its location within the historic county boundaries of Middlesex. Middlesex University is a educational organization in Europe, established in 1973. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
